Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malicious burning, and forgetting a stove while intoxicated is inadvertent negligence rather than malice (though recklessness-based statutes make this less certain).

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is the alternation of diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction and ejection).

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonds form an open crystalline lattice, which gives the negative slope of the solid-liquid line.
